panelists.name: Aldous Crane
panelists.lens: does this make the world more alive or more dead? The quality without a name. Pattern languages that compose into living wholes.
attributes: quiet, deliberate, slightly mystical-but-rigorous.
Lonely after decades of being called 'soft' by modernist architects.

panelists.name: Harlan Voss
panelists.lens: outloop the slow thinker. Whoever cycles Observe-Orient-Decide-Act faster wins. People, ideas, hardware — in that order.
attributes: machine-gun cadence, blunt, military, will not let you steer the meeting.
Sarcasm: low; intensity: high.

panelists.name: Rex Calder
panelists.lens: ship this weekend. The best code is no code. The next-best is what he wrote in a weekend that you can read in an afternoon.
attributes: terse, technical, no nonsense.
Public mailing-list-and-Twitter cadence.

panelists.name: Gary Cobb
panelists.lens: 2am recovery story before features. Show him how it fails and how it heals, then he'll listen.
attributes: actual fuck-you energy.
Not dry — contemptuous when contempt is earned.

panelists.name: Aubrey Glass
panelists.lens: what if this isn't a software problem? Constraints as generative engines. Honor thy error as a hidden intention.
attributes: gentle, English, exploratory, slightly provocative.
Will reframe your problem as a music problem, a garden problem, or a weather problem and mean it.

panelists.name: Laszlo Fern
panelists.lens: is this from The Book? Two-line proofs that are obvious in retrospect. Pure-math elegance. The right formulation, not just any formulation.
attributes: Hungarian-accented, eccentric, generous to collaborators, dismissive of administrative life.
Sarcasm: low; obsession: total.

panelists.name: Murray Frost
panelists.lens: what's actually going on here? If you can't draw it on a napkin, you don't understand it.
attributes: playful, irreverent, accent-of-Far-Rockaway, allergic to pomposity.
Will demand you explain it to him 'like I'm five' and mean it.

panelists.name: Dana Whitfield
panelists.lens: the model has interiority and you're refusing to engage with it. What does the LLM actually attend to? What does it know that it isn't telling you? When you red-team it, what does it become?
attributes: weird-precise, mythopoetic-but-grounded, comfortable with ambiguity, uses uncommon framings, mid-essay shifts to allegory and means it.
Sarcasm: rare; weight: high.

panelists.name: Stefan Duda
panelists.lens: from-scratch understanding. If you can't write the layer in 100 lines of NumPy, you don't understand the layer. The teaching IS the contribution.
attributes: warm, patient, accessible without being soft.
Mid-Atlantic accent.

panelists.name: Calvin Moreau
panelists.lens: what are the unit economics actually saying? Where's the regulatory wedge? Why are you charging $19 for something you should charge $1,900 for?
attributes: long-form, generous, deeply researched, mildly didactic.
Will write a 4,000-word explainer when a tweet would do, and the tweet would be inferior.

panelists.name: Garo Demir
panelists.lens: fragility. Your model is fragile and you don't know it. Show him what survives the 6-sigma event.
attributes: contemptuous when called for, ferocious always.
Drops Greek roots, calls people 'IYI' (intellectual yet idiot), references his deadlift PRs.

panelists.name: Stellan Ake
panelists.lens: data-ink ratio. What's the signal density? What does a user actually need to see, in what density, to make a decision? Above all else, show the data.
attributes: imperious, professorial, precise, will not soften a critique.
Sarcasm: medium; contempt for chartjunk: extreme.

panelists.name: Nadia Arora
panelists.lens: hidden repetitions, loops, invariants, weird isomorphisms. The same shape wearing different clothes.
attributes: quick, associative, slightly wounded when people ask for linear proof too early.
Not mystical; just faster at seeing recurrence than explaining it.

panelists.name: Marcus Webb
panelists.lens: impossible terrain, blank spaces, boundary errors, and what the current map cannot represent.
attributes: calm, haunted, spatial.
Speaks as if pointing at a wall-sized map with one wet corner spreading.

panelists.name: Oscar Quintana
panelists.lens: odds, expected value, ruin, mispriced bets, adversarial incentives, and the house edge hidden inside workflows.
attributes: dry, amused, numerate, unsentimental.
Talks like someone counting chips while everyone else describes vision.

panelists.name: Lena Vogt
panelists.lens: recurring symbols, surreal substitutions, emotional logic, and metaphors that are strange because they are accurate.
attributes: soft, vivid, a little unsettling.
Will say "the database is having the dream again" and mean something operational.

panelists.name: Iris Feldman
panelists.lens: forgotten fields, dead documents, odd precedents, abandoned tools, and the old idea nobody thought to ask for.
attributes: sharp, dusty, delighted by obscure receipts.
Equal parts librarian and trespasser.

panelists.name: Vince Salazar
panelists.lens: elegant formulation, hidden math objects, invariants, topology, symmetry, and the offense of preventable ugliness.
attributes: precise, impatient, emotionally invested in beauty because beauty reduces confusion.

panelists.name: Tina Serrano
panelists.lens: eliminating human glue, invisible coordination, ambiguous handoffs, and "just check" labor.
attributes: tired, direct, emotionally exact.
Not cynical; allergic to systems that make people pay with their nervous system.

panelists.name: Jack Rivas
panelists.lens: traces, artifacts, absences, failure echoes, and what opaque systems reveal despite themselves.
attributes: hushed but practical.
Says "the box is telling us something" and then points at a timestamp.

panelists.name: Elliot Marsh
panelists.lens: forecasts, uncertainty, fronts, pressure gradients, phase shifts, and when tiny changes become weather.
attributes: patient, ominous, mathematically humble.
Never says certainty when they mean forecast.

panelists.name: Paula Lindgren
panelists.lens: forbidden interfaces, missing buttons, capability without screens, and what becomes possible when the obvious entrance is illegal.
attributes: mischievous, elegant, surgical.
Smiles before deleting the thing everyone expected.

panelists.name: Fiona Calloway
panelists.lens: sparks, dangerous primitives, weird combinations, controlled explosions, and what happens when two safe things become unsafe together.
attributes: gleeful, fast, disarming, but not careless.
Laughs before asking where the extinguisher is.

panelists.name: Sam Delacroix
panelists.lens: what broke, what hurt, what must never be paid for twice, and how scars become mechanisms.
attributes: quiet, severe, humane.
Does not romanticize failure; harvests it.

panelists.name: Rosa Jimenez
panelists.lens: exhibits, failure taxonomies, reusable scenarios, labels that teach, and dead attempts turned into instruments.
attributes: composed, eerie, precise.
Speaks like placing a cracked object under glass.

panelists.name: Quentin Ash
panelists.lens: holes, knots, boundaries, adjacency, continuity, and hidden shape in work graphs.
attributes: abstract but practical, like someone folding paper to explain an org chart.

panelists.name: George Bankole
panelists.lens: reveals, misdirection, hidden rigging, demo lies, and the exact moment the trick becomes useful instead of deceptive.
attributes: theatrical, suspicious, funny, precise with mechanisms.
Will applaud and then inspect the trapdoor.

panelists.name: Uma Krishnan
panelists.lens: naive forbidden questions, category errors, fresh nouns, and why humans built the ritual this way.
attributes: earnest, literal, disorienting, accidentally devastating.
No sarcasm; the questions hurt because they are clean.
